body:
**Goal.** Measure the premise honestly: only the past is ever available.

## Scope
- Rolling-origin backtest: index = rows before month m, test = month m.
- Results per method and per confidence band, stratified into memo seen before vs novel; gate thresholds set on the novel stratum.
- Leave-one-out only as an upper bound; token-Bayes control for comparison.
- CLI that writes a report file; set `[manual_test].cmd` in autobook-pdca once it exists.

## Done when (red→green)
On the planted synthetic corpus the harness reports the known precision/coverage; a future row never votes for a past one.

Synthetic data only: no real statement, memo, IBAN, document or correspondent name in any fixture.

**Depends on:** #24

**Design:** [proposal 0001](https://github.com/Ralphovi/autobook/blob/main/docs/design/proposals/draft/0001-gnucash-auto-booking-pipeline.md) (*Scenario 1*), [architecture ch.6](https://github.com/Ralphovi/autobook/blob/main/docs/design/architecture/06-runtime-view.md), [architecture ch.8](https://github.com/Ralphovi/autobook/blob/main/docs/design/architecture/08-crosscutting-concepts.md)
